Class SignatureTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.SignatureTck
public abstract class SignatureTck extends AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
Erasure and generic signatures: descriptors, Signature attributes, type annotations and member flags of generated classes, compared with the classes javac writes from the same declarations.

A backend runs these tests by extending this class and implementing AbstractByteCodeWriterTck.write(io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ObjectDef).

Since:
2.3

      @ParameterizedTest(name="{0} / {1} / {2}") @MethodSource("genericSignatureCases") public void genericSignaturesMatchJavac(Class<?> reference, boolean inline, String part) throws Exception
      Checks metadata and descriptors independently, with name-only and inline-bound references.
      Parameters:
      reference - The fixture javac compiled
      inline - Whether the model writes type variables inline with their bounds rather than by name
      part - The part of the class compared with javac's
      Throws:
      Exception - If the generated class cannot be loaded
